pattern: undo a bulk edit found in Recent changes

pattern: finish a Zotero import larger than one call
experience: A Zotero library of 503 references comes in two calls. The agent goes on with the run ID until nothing remains, then stops. Reporting success after the first 500 leaves three references behind.
